Tank.name: Iron Wall
Tank.text: Holds 4 enemies instead of 3; its attacks deal 30% less damage.

Tank.name: Thorns
Tank.text: Enemies that hit it take 25% of the damage back.

Warrior.name: Whirlwind
Warrior.text: The cleave strikes every enemy in its pattern for 50% (instead of up to 5 for 70%).

Warrior.name: Duelist
Warrior.text: No cleave; +50% damage to the enemy it holds, +100% against Elites and bosses.

Assassin.name: Stalker
Assassin.text: Dash reach +50%; always hunts enemies nobody holds, runners first.

Assassin.name: Executioner
Assassin.text: Its hits finish ground enemies (not bosses) below 12% health.

Mage.name: Focus Lens
Mage.text: No splash; +35% damage to the main target (chain bounces stay).

Archer.name: Piercing Shot
Archer.text: Each arrow flies on through its target and hits up to 2 more enemies in line for 60%.

Archer.name: Multishot
Archer.text: Shoots 2 targets at once for 65% each.

Support.name: Warden
Support.text: Healing beyond full health becomes a barrier for 6 s (up to 20% of max health).

Support.name: War Hymn
Support.text: Heals 40% less; its attack aura is 60% stronger.

atlas.name: World's Weight
atlas.text: Allies in his pattern also get the shield.

ymir.name: Giant's Reach
ymir.text: Expose covers a wider area, shorter duration.

heimdall.name: Rainbow Bridge
heimdall.text: The ward also covers neighbouring allies at half strength.

heimdall.name: Gjallarhorn
heimdall.text: When the ward ends it bursts and stuns enemies around him.

aegir.name: Undertow
aegir.text: Weaker knockback, enemies are Wet and slowed.

aegir.name: Rogue Wave
aegir.text: Knockback twice as far, fewer targets.

helios.name: Blinding Noon
helios.text: Struck enemies deal 30% less damage for a few seconds.

surtr.name: Blood Pact
surtr.text: The lifesteal also heals neighbouring allies.

fenrir.name: Lock Jaw
fenrir.text: The bitten target is held in place (stun).

fenrir.name: Pack Howl
fenrir.text: Neighbouring allies attack faster for a few seconds.

nott.name: Eclipse
nott.text: After the step she is veiled for 2 s.

hecate.name: Three Roads
hecate.text: The sweep reaches every tile around her.

hecate.name: Torchlight
hecate.text: The sweep leaves fire that burns.

vidar.name: Vengeance
vidar.text: The flurry grows stronger the more health he is missing.

thanatos.name: Reaper
thanatos.text: The judgment finishes enemies below 15% health.

thanatos.name: Soul Harvest
thanatos.text: Every kill during the ultimate refunds charge.

odin.name: Rune Mark
odin.text: The struck target takes 20% more damage from everyone for 6 s.

hephaestus.name: Forge Bed
hephaestus.text: The molten area lasts longer and is wider.

hephaestus.name: Hammerfall
hephaestus.text: One heavy blow instead of the pool, with a short stun.

boreas.name: Northwind
boreas.text: The shockwave pushes enemies back one tile.

atalanta.name: Wind Step
atalanta.text: Every shot in the window slows its target.

stheno.name: Stone Stare
stheno.text: One target, longer petrify, works on Elites.

asclepius.name: Second Life
asclepius.text: Once per stage, a fallen ally returns at 30% health.

asclepius.name: Serpent Rod
asclepius.text: The heal turns into healing over time for the whole squad.

gaia.name: Deep Roots
gaia.text: Stronger ward, she cannot be relocated while it holds.

gaia.name: Overgrowth
gaia.text: The sanctuary also roots enemies in her pattern.
